[SWS_DM_00847] Reinitialization of Service Instance on Cancellation of a Diag-
nostic Conversation
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04167
⌈
On Cancellation of a
Diagnostic Conversation
, the
Diagnostic Server
instance
shall reset the values of the fields of the associated
ara::diag::Con-
versation
class Instance according to [SWS_DM_00843].
